author: desktop_review
scope: Prepared locally and validated /proc parsing on build host; no board, application, display, clock, cache or affinity operations by this reviewer.

verified_panel_ids.static_control: multitasking; four SVG assets in cc-multitasking-panel.ui; cc-mask-paintable.c:448–457 bypasses GtkMediaFile for .svg
verified_panel_ids.media_control: mouse; nine WebM resources; constructed during panel setup, play/pause on hover; already proven installed in v16 board logs

preconditions: Run only after v20 boots and passes the unchanged bounded storage integrity probe; retain kernel/DT/module hashes and boot ID.

Use the existing parent-owned desktop-session runner as t736, preserving DISPLAY, XAUTHORITY, DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS and all validated GPU variables. Do not reconstruct only part of the environment.

Validated GPU values include LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/t736-img-ddk-24.2-x11/runtime-gles; LIBGL_DRIVERS_PATH=/opt/t736-img-ddk-24.2-x11/runtime-gles/dri; GDK_BACKEND=x11; GDK_DISABLE=gl-api,glx,vulkan; GSK_RENDERER=opengl. Preserve session-specific display/auth/bus values.
Record unlocked session and Overview inactive at start/end with the existing parent check. Keep1080p60, all8CPUs and430x6/1024x2 capacity unchanged. Do not bind CPUs or alter governor.
Wrapper refuses launch if sameUID Settings exists. --reuse-pid is explicit and requires the selected process to be the sole sameUID Settings executable. No default kill.

Close only a Settings instance owned by this measurement between new-process cases; do not kill a pre-existing user Settings window. CLI panel activation may update Settings own last-panel preference.

minimum_run_sequence.meaning: New Settings process with static SVG panel; mapped latency and startup CPU/IO. Label first-use/cache-unknown, not cache-cold.
Same process activates multimedia panel. Dispatch return is not panel-ready timing; compare20s CPU, thread andIO work plus actual observed panel.
Return to static panel. If needed repeat mouse once for within-process warm comparison using a new result filename.

optional_media_isolation_after_primary_r.method: Use separately launched mouse processes with full unchanged GPU environment: default, GTK_MEDIA=none, default; each needs previous measured process closed and new result filename. --media none sets only the launched child environment. Never pass it with --reuse-pid.
optional_media_isolation_after_primary_r.interpretation: A reduction is evidence for media setup/animation cost under those cache/order conditions; it removes illustrations and is not a production fix or proof of hardware video decoding.

metrics.launch: x11_window_wait.py reports first IsViewable matching _NET_WM_PID. Poll0.05s plus scheduling observer delay. No first paint or complete render claim.
metrics.switch: CLI request exit observed on0.5s polling. Request was dispatched/returned; this does not prove target page visibly finished. Existing mapped window cannot supply switch latency.
metrics.cpu: Process utime+stime deltas divided by sysconfCLK_TCK; per-thread lower bounds, lastCPU samples and main-thread state/wchan. Process CPU includes its threads but excludes kworker/IRQ work. Counters are tick-quantized and can miss short activities.
metrics.io: /proc/PID/io read_bytes/write_bytes and rchar/wchar deltas; majorfaults and optional blkio_delay ticks. Kernel delayacct may be unavailable so zero does not prove noIO wait. MMC device statistics contain unrelated backgroundIO.
metrics.gpu: Requested environment and mapped libraries plus application stderr. LoadedPVR libraries alone do not prove actualGSK renderer or GPU use. Retain known realGSK probe and driver counters separately.
metrics.observer: Observer self CPU reported; per-task polling can perturb a heavily threaded app. Same interval is required across compared cases. Reported observer CPU excludes separate x11_window_wait subprocess.

separation_rules: CPU-bound: processCPU and busiestthreadCPU rise during delay, read_bytes low; inspect main-thread CPU6/7 sampling and media/background workers. Do not infer full residency from lastCPU.

Storage contribution: fresh launch has real read_bytes/majorfaults plus blocked/wchan evidence, warm case improves. A busy MMC kworker alone is not attribution to Settings; correlate timestamps and processIO.

Media contribution: mouse disproportionately expensive versus static panel, GtkGstPlay/GL/media threads active, new-process GTK_MEDIA=none reduces work with GSK environment unchanged. Library presence alone is not playback or hardware decoding evidence.

Timer/scheduler contribution: with otherwise identical kernels/clocks/workload, v20 high-resolution timing improves short sleep accuracy and UI without a comparable reduction in processCPU/IO. Avoid inferring causation from one cache-ordered run.

First paint: this read-only/proc wrapper cannot measure it. Keep first_paint_verified=false. Existing parent screenshot/video can record that a requested panel is visibly complete at a known later sample time, which is an upper bound/observation, not exact first-paint time.

Do not drop global caches. For optional thumbnail isolation later, preserve font/GStreamer/GSK caches and isolate only thumbnails; do not claim all ofXDG_CACHE_HOME cold is a wallpaper-only experiment.

validation.linux_proc_parser_and_counter_math: PASS; synthetic0.12CPU-second burn measured0.12s using/proc counters
validation.independent_static_review: backup_audit: /proc field indexes correct. Requested PID boundary checks added: UID/exe and start_ticks checks before activation and across snapshots; zero/negative reuse PID rejected.
